newsitem.title: ESTONIA: EESTI MOBIILTELEFON, TALLINN PORT ISSUE CPS.
newsitem.headline: EESTI MOBIILTELEFON, TALLINN PORT ISSUE CPS.

text.p: Eesti Mobiiltelefon on Monday issued commercial papers worth 50 million kroons and Tallinn Port worth 20 million kroons, Hansapank said.

Eesti Mobiiltelefon (EMT) three-months CPs yield is 7.52 percent, which is the lowest among Estonia's three-month commercial paper issuers, Ulo Kallas, Hansapank interest rate product manager, told Reuters.
"EMT is the best issuer in our opinion as its equity has a high stake in its balance sheet and they were able to generate a net profit of 160 million kroons last year," Kallas said.
"There is no doubt they can pay the loan back," he added.
Tallinn Port issued 20 million kroons of three-month CPs, with a yield of 8.23 percent.
